sequences.title: Mode A, S2: robot holds the specimen, D405 fixed
sequences.desc: The gripper takes the S2 handle and presents the surface 80 mm under the docked D405 for a raster scan (x ±60 mm, rows at y = 0, 25 and 50 mm; the half with y < -10 mm would hit the profile, so it is scanned in Mode B), then puts S2 back on the riser.
phaseLabel: Move to the S2 handle pre-grasp
Approach along the handle axis (gripper open, 85 mm)
Lift 50 mm straight up, clear of the locating pins
Turn towards the dock through the via pose
Bring below the front of the D405
Slide under the D405 (80 mm working distance)
Raster scan row 1/3 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Raster scan row 2/3 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Raster scan row 3/3 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Turn back to the riser through the via pose
Lower straight down onto the locating pins

sequences.title: Mode B, S2: robot holds the camera tool, specimen fixed
sequences.desc: The gripper takes the camera tool from the dock and scans S2 along its surface normal at 80 mm (x ±60 mm, rows at y = -40, 0 and 40 mm), then returns the tool to the dock.
phaseLabel: Move above the front of the dock
Descend straight onto the camera tool handle
Lift 60 mm straight out of the dock
Close in to the 80 mm working distance
Raster scan row 1/3 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Raster scan row 2/3 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Raster scan row 3/3 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Back off along the optical axis
Return above the front of the dock
Lower straight back onto the three-ball kinematic mount

sequences.title: Mode A, S4: robot holds the specimen, D405 fixed
sequences.desc: The gripper takes the S4 handle and presents the surface 80 mm under the docked D405 for a raster scan (x ±60 mm, five rows at normal angles -30, -15, 0, 15 and 20 deg; at +30 deg the wrist would hit the table), then puts S4 back on the riser.
phaseLabel: Move to the S4 handle pre-grasp
Approach along the handle axis (gripper open, 85 mm)
Lift 50 mm straight up, clear of the locating pins
Turn towards the dock through the via pose
Bring below the front of the D405
Slide under the D405 (80 mm working distance)
Raster scan row 1/5 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Raster scan row 2/5 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Raster scan row 3/5 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Raster scan row 4/5 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Raster scan row 5/5 (D405 fixed, robot moves the specimen)
Turn back to the riser through the via pose
Lower straight down onto the locating pins

sequences.title: Mode B, S4: robot holds the camera tool, specimen fixed
sequences.desc: The gripper takes the camera tool from the dock and scans S4 along its surface normal at 80 mm (x ±60 mm, five rows from -30 to +30 deg), then returns the tool to the dock.
phaseLabel: Move above the front of the dock
Descend straight onto the camera tool handle
Lift 60 mm straight out of the dock
Close in to the 80 mm working distance
Raster scan row 1/5 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Raster scan row 2/5 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Raster scan row 3/5 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Raster scan row 4/5 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Raster scan row 5/5 (specimen fixed, robot moves the D405)
Back off along the optical axis
Return above the front of the dock
Lower straight back onto the three-ball kinematic mount

sequences.title: Calibration A, eye to hand: robot holds the paddle, D405 fixed
sequences.desc: The gripper takes the paddle handle and shows the board to the fixed D405 in 8 poses (tilt ±15 deg, 140 to 180 mm away), holding 1 s at each.
phaseLabel: Move to the calibration paddle handle pre-grasp
Approach along the handle axis (gripper open, 85 mm)
Lift 50 mm straight up, clear of the locating pins
Turn back to the riser through the via pose
Lower straight down onto the locating pins

sequences.title: Calibration B, eye in hand: robot holds the camera tool, paddle fixed
sequences.desc: The camera tool is taken from the dock and views the paddle on the riser from 8 poses (tilt 0 to 20 deg, 150 to 220 mm away), holding 1 s at each, then the tool is returned.
phaseLabel: Move above the front of the dock
Descend straight onto the camera tool handle
Lift 60 mm straight out of the dock
Return above the front of the dock
Lower straight back onto the three-ball kinematic mount
